name: WdRecoveryType
description: Specifies the formatting to use when pasting the selected table cells.

constants.name: wdSingleCellText
constants.description: Pastes a single cell as text.

constants.name: wdSingleCellTable
constants.description: Pastes a single cell table as a separate table.

constants.name: wdListContinueNumbering
constants.description: Continues numbering of a pasted list from the list in the document.

constants.name: wdListRestartNumbering
constants.description: Restarts numbering of a pasted list.

constants.name: wdTableInsertAsRows
constants.description: Inserts a pasted table as rows between two rows in the target table.

constants.name: wdTableAppendTable
constants.description: Merges pasted cells into an existing table by inserting the pasted rows between the selected rows.

constants.name: wdTableOriginalFormatting
constants.description: Pastes an appended table without merging table styles.

constants.name: wdChartPicture
constants.description: Pastes an Excel chart as a picture.

constants.name: wdChart
constants.description: Pastes a Microsoft Office Excel chart as an embedded OLE object.

constants.name: wdChartLinked
constants.description: Pastes an Excel chart and links it to the original Excel spreadsheet.

constants.name: wdFormatOriginalFormatting
constants.description: Preserves original formatting of the pasted material.

constants.name: wdFormatSurroundingFormattingWithEmphasis
constants.description: Matches the formatting of the pasted text to the formatting of surrounding text.

constants.name: wdTableOverwriteCells
constants.description: Pastes table cells and overwrites existing table cells.

constants.name: wdListCombineWithExistingList
constants.description: Merges a pasted list with neighboring lists.

constants.name: wdUseDestinationStylesRecovery
constants.description: Uses the styles that are in use in the destination document.
